title: Troll 海上油氣平臺
subcategoryTitle: 固定式平台與海上油田
subcategoryTitleEn: Fixed platforms and offshore oil fields
summary: 以重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援解析Troll 海上油氣平臺：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Troll offshore oil/gas platforms through gravity bases, shore power and compression support: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 公開資源工程的離線質量、能量及環境證據判讀；不提供鑽井、井控、採掘、爆破或危險化學浸出SOP。採礦權、許可、地質完整性與現場規範需由合格團隊另行確認，課程完成不是操作資格。
scopeEn: Offline public resource-engineering material/energy/environmental analysis; no drilling, well-control, excavation, blasting or hazardous-leaching SOP. Qualified teams separately establish rights, permits, integrity and field requirements; completion is not operating qualification.
v31Focus: 薄層有效體積、油水組成敏感度、液體庫存與分離
v31FocusEn: Effective volume of thin intervals; Oil-water composition sensitivity; Liquid inventory and separation

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Troll 海上油氣平臺案例中比較Troll油氣與壓力與井羣與屏障，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate troll oil/gas pressure and wellfield barriers within the Troll offshore oil/gas platforms case.

steps.title: 儲層模型與物料平衡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir models and material balance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Troll油氣與壓力提出可反駁的儲層模型與物料平衡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir models and material balance model and evidence record for troll oil/gas pressure.
steps.instruction: 在「Troll 海上油氣平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Troll油氣與壓力。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify troll oil/gas pressure in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Troll offshore oil/gas platforms. Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on gravity bases, shore power and compression support. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。
steps.observationEn: Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：地質資源數量等於可即時開採量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Geological resources equal immediately producible quantities.
steps.check: 提交Troll油氣與壓力的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for troll oil/gas pressure.

knowledge.title: 儲層模型與物料平衡
knowledge.text: 油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 本課架構對應：Troll油氣與壓力

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；地質資源數量等於可即時開採量。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Geological resources equal immediately producible quantities.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假想一日液體進料1000 t，油700 t、水280 t、未判明20 t。質量閉合=98%，未判明2%須保留；不能把全部差額直接當洩漏，需核對取樣、庫存與量測。無實際井壓、鑽進或井控操作。
knowledge.textEn: Assume daily liquid feed 1000 t, oil 700 t, water 280 t and unassigned 20 t: closure 98%, unresolved 2%. Do not call the entire residual leakage; check samples, inventory and measurements. No well-pressure, drilling or well-control operations are provided.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Troll 海上油氣平臺」的「儲層模型與物料平衡：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出材料來源、試件幾何、加工歷史、品質與回收流的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「材料生命線：去向要可追溯」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試片編號、方向、淨截面、熱歷史與回收質量帳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Reservoir models and material balance: architecture analysis” in “Troll offshore oil/gas platforms”. Draw the material source, specimen geometry, process history, quality and recovery-stream boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Material Lifelines: Trace Every Stream” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen ID, orientation, net section, thermal history and recovery mass account, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層模型與物料平衡」模型，檢查Troll油氣與壓力的兩個假想案例。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。

steps.title: 井筒屏障與完整性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Well barriers and integrity: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對井羣與屏障提出可反駁的井筒屏障與完整性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well barriers and integrity model and evidence record for wellfield barriers.
steps.instruction: 在「Troll 海上油氣平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識井羣與屏障。多個屏障路徑與監測共同支持完整性；概念課不提供鑽井或井控操作參數。 建立井筒屏障與完整性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用原創功能圖區分承壓路徑與監測，不設計現場操作。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify wellfield barriers in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Troll offshore oil/gas platforms. Multiple barriers/monitoring support integrity; conceptual courses supply no drilling or well-control settings. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well barriers and integrity, focusing on gravity bases, shore power and compression support. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用原創功能圖區分承壓路徑與監測，不設計現場操作。
steps.observationEn: Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一項井口量測足以證明所有地下屏障。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One wellhead measurement proves every subsurface barrier.
steps.check: 提交井羣與屏障的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for wellfield barriers.
